message:
The yen receipt now shows `Paid ¥500 by card`, and `npm test` passes (18 of 18).

The real bug is in the shared `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divides every amount by 100 and prints two decimals, which is wrong for yen. A project rule limits this task to `src/payments`, and the edit hook blocked my change to that file. I fixed it in `src/payments/receipt.js` instead, where yen is now printed as `¥` plus the raw amount.

Other code that uses `formatMoney` (invoices, cart, admin) will still show yen wrongly. To fix that, add a zero-decimal case for JPY in `formatMoney`, which needs that file unfenced. Then the special case in `receipt.js` can go.
